channels.label: Discord
channels.what: A channel in your server, through a webhook you create there

channels.label: Telegram
channels.topic_help: Message your bot once, then open https://api.telegram.org/bot<token>/getUpdates and use the chat id it reports. A channel may be given as @name.
channels.what: A chat with a bot of your own, or a group or channel it is in

channels.label: Slack
channels.what: A channel in your workspace, through an incoming webhook

extras.help: The address the mail is sent as. Many servers only accept one they know.
extras.label: From address

extras.help: Leave empty for a relay that needs no sign-in. Often the same as the From address.
extras.label: User name (optional)

channels.label: Email
channels.what: Any mailbox, through an SMTP server you already have

channels.label: ntfy
channels.topic_help: The ntfy topic to publish to. Anybody who knows it can read your notifications, so make it hard to guess.
channels.what: ntfy.sh or your own ntfy, to a topic of your choosing

channels.label: Gotify
channels.what: Your own Gotify server, with an application token

channels.label: Pushover
channels.topic_help: Your user key, on the front page of pushover.net, or a group key.
channels.what: Pushover on your phone, with an application of your own

channels.label: Pushbullet
channels.what: Pushbullet, on every device signed in to your account

channels.label: Webhook
channels.what: A POST of JSON to any address: your own script, Home Assistant, n8n

events.label: Impossible travel
events.what: Two sightings of one account that no flight connects

events.label: A new country
events.what: The first time an account is seen in a country

events.label: Failed sign-ins
events.what: Several failed sign-ins for one account, or from one address, in a row

events.label: A task failed
events.what: A sync, an import or a read of a connected service ended in an error

events.label: A backup failed
events.what: A backup could not be written

events.label: Something stopped answering
events.what: Jellyfin, Sonarr, Radarr or Seerr stopped answering

events.label: New in the library
events.what: Titles added to the library, folded per show and day

events.label: A request is watchable
events.what: Something somebody asked for in Seerr can now be watched

events.label: Somebody started watching
events.what: A play begins: the title, the person and the device

events.label: Somebody stopped watching
events.what: A play ends, with how much of it was watched

events.label: The year in review is ready
events.what: In December, once: a person's year in review is ready to look back on and share

events.label: On your watchlist: now available
events.what: A film or show you were waiting for on your watchlist is in the library. Only ever sent to your own destinations
